name: requirements_create
description: Create a requirement entry. type = fr|tr|test|mapping. For mapping, body is comma-separated TR ids and testIds is comma-separated TEST ids.

type.description: Entry type: fr, tr, test, or mapping

id.description: Entry id (FR/TR/TEST id or FR id for mapping rows)

title.description: Title (required for fr; optional for tr; ignored for test/mapping)

body.description: Body text (required for fr/tr/test; for mapping use comma-separated TR ids)

testIds.description: Comma-separated TEST ids for mapping rows
